copy.tagline: 快速启动创意或架构决策的头脑风暴流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在开始创意或架构工作前需要快速聚焦决策
copy.tagline_en: Kickstart a streamlined brainstorming process for creative or architectural decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need fast, focused decision-making before starting creative or architectural work

howto.what: 在开始创意或架构工作前，先暂停并引导你进行快速头脑风暴，帮你理清需求、比较方案、做出决定，然后才开始编码。
howto.when: 当你提出功能设计、组件创建或行为变更等创意或架构任务时触发。

say.text: 我想给应用加一个用户登录功能，先帮我 brainstorm 一下。
say.note: 触发发现阶段，Claude 会提问并给出方案。

say.text: 我需要设计一个新的数据导出模块，有什么好的方案？
say.note: Claude 会提出两种方案并推荐一个。

howto.what_en: Before starting creative or architectural work, it pauses and guides you through a quick brainstorming process to clarify needs, compare options, and make a decision before writing any code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you propose a creative or architectural task such as feature design, component creation, or behavioral changes.

say_en.text: I want to add a login feature to the app. Let's brainstorm first.
say_en.note: Triggers the discovery phase; Claude will ask questions and propose options.

say_en.text: I need to design a new data export module. What are some good approaches?
say_en.note: Claude will present two approaches with trade-offs and a recommendation.
